title: Bo came as Sandy Claws
topic: Christmas 2026 greeting: Bo dresses as Santa and calls himself Sandy Claws, plans to go down the chimney sideways, then wishes everyone a merry Christmas. Shows the Santa's Workshop gear.
hookHeadline: Bo says he's Santa. Sort of.

scenes.speaker: juno
scenes.line: Bo, the kids keep asking who you're meant to be.
scenes.description: Two-shot on a snowy moonlit sea floor: Juno in an elf tunic and pointed elf hat points at Bo, who struts in a full Santa suit, hat, belt and boots.

scenes.speaker: bo
scenes.description: Close on Bo, proud, snapping a claw on 'Claws'.

scenes.speaker: juno
scenes.line: You can't even fit down a chimney.
scenes.description: Medium on Juno, doubtful, looking across at Bo.

scenes.speaker: bo
scenes.line: Don't need to. I go down sideways.
scenes.description: Extreme close-up on Bo, completely serious.

scenes.speaker: juno
scenes.line: That is not how chimneys work.
scenes.description: Slow push-in on Juno, unimpressed, elf hat bell catching the light.

scenes.speaker: bo
scenes.line: Merry Christmas from the whole reef!
scenes.description: Both wave at the camera under a red and cream 'Merry Christmas' title, marine snow drifting down.

caption:
Bo has thought this through. Bo has not thought this through.

Merry Christmas from all of us.

#Christmas #CrabLogic #Moltology
